input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for appointments, jwt token manager. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with appointments functionality, so that I can accomplish my appointments-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use appointments capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
